newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT - Stg to struggle for gains above 2.78 marks.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT - Stg to struggle for gains above 2.78 marks.

text.p: The pound has near-term potential to climb to 2.78 marks but with retracement barriers lining up above there, the upside looks limited, chartists said.
"We think that increasingly sterling/mark is marking time before it makes a serious attack on support," said Brian Kiely, treasury technician at Royal Bank of Scotland here.
Kiely saw resistance at 2.7822 and 2.7850 marks, which he said represented 61.8 and 66.6 percent retracements respectively of sterling's recent drop from around 2.8081 to 2.7403.
The pound was quoted at 2.7758/63 marks at 0801 GMT, up from late Monday's European level of 2.7711/21.
Ian Stannard, technical analyst at Chase Investment Bank here, pitched key resistance at 2.7785, an intraday level within the current downleg.
"As long as we stay below 2.7785, it looks like the bounce we've seen is corrective and we're still in a sequence to the downside," Stannard said.
Renewed losses would target near-term trendline support at 2.7475 and then last week's lows near 2.7420, he added.
Cable also has potential for mild near-term gains, but here too the topside appears restricted, chart watchers said.
RSI - 14 day: Stg/mark: 49 pct, Stg/dollar: 52 pct
